title: Brief
body: Send your footage, audio and notes. I confirm length, format, captions and deadline before I cut, so we agree on the result upfront.
factBasis: FACTS.md › Positioning: communication is a cornerstone of her workflow

title: First cut
body: I sync cameras, clean the audio, cut for pace and add titles, lower thirds or subtitles. You get a first version to review, on the date we set.
factBasis: FACTS.md › Work history: background static removal; lower thirds + subtitles

title: Revisions
body: Tell me what to change. I make the edits and keep you updated — no chasing, no guessing.
factBasis: FACTS.md › Review, Miles B.: "made all the changes we needed"

title: Delivery
body: Final files, ready to publish, on time. Urgent? I have delivered next-day.
factBasis: FACTS.md › Review, Dan R.: "delivers on time"
FACTS.md › Work history: urgent next-day delivery
